articles.author: SurgePays, Inc.
articles.headline: SurgePays Forms Redline Wireless Group to Scale LinkUp Mobile Across 20,000 Plus Dealers
articles.summary: SurgePays announced formation of the Redline Wireless distribution joint venture, with access to a dealer network exceeding 20,000. Subscriber and cash-flow goals remained projections.

articles.author: SurgePays, Inc.
articles.headline: SurgePays Expands Prepaid Wireless Distribution with Formation of Redline Wireless Group Across 20,000 Plus Dealers, Targeting More Than 1 Million Subscribers
articles.summary: A separately published follow-up outlined Redline's distribution reach and targeted more than one million subscribers. The target is not an existing subscribed customer count.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original GlobeNewswire August 6, 2026 09:15 ET; corroborated by Stockwatch and Finviz.
